core_meaning.primary_meaning: Madinah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “City, settlement”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Madinah corresponds to the Arabic form مدينة (Arabic root م د ن (m-d-n); مَدِينَة (Madīna)). Its core sense is city, settlement. Madinah is Arabic مَدِينَة (Madīna) 'city, settlement', from the root م د ن (m-d-n); it is also the name of the city of Medina. The source gloss 'City, settlement' is consistent.

persian.name: مدینه
persian.long_meaning: Madinah (مدینه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن مدینه، شهر، آبادی است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: मदीना

arabic.name: مدينة
